samples.no: Do not add samples (initial administrator and required settings only)
samples.yes: Add localized samples: 360 employees, six branches, 128 IT assets, notes and history
locale.name: English
error.docker: Docker failed while checking existing containers or storage. The underlying cause could not be determined safely. Check that Docker is running and that your account can access it.
error.permissions: Could not secure the permissions of a configuration file. Check folder ownership, write permissions and security software.
title: INSTALLATION
progress.notice: Seven stages. Installation may take a few minutes.
error.existingConfiguration: An existing .env was found in the installation folder. This installer is for a new installation and cannot overwrite existing configuration. Keep .env and database storage.
error.dockerRequired: The docker command was not found. Install Docker with Docker Compose, then reopen the terminal and start Docker before running this installer.
error.existingResources: SPH containers or the sph-db-data volume already exist. A new installation was stopped to protect existing data. Keep these resources.
error.setup: The setup input container failed or input was cancelled. Configuration may already have been saved. Check the message above, use an interactive terminal, and confirm folder write permissions.
error.migration: Could not confirm successful completion of the database migration job. Check the migration service status and database connectivity. Keep .env and database storage.
error.initialCredentials: Initial setup credentials still remain in a service. Installation cannot be marked complete. Remove INITIAL_ADMIN_* settings and recreate the affected services; do not delete database storage.
warning.publicUrl: Local startup succeeded. Public URL could not be verified; check DNS, firewall and HTTPS proxy settings.
complete.notice: Sign in with the username and password you entered. Keep .env secure and back it up separately from the database.
error.stoppedWindows: Installation stopped. Do not delete .env or database storage to retry. No secrets are displayed.
stage.setup: Preparing runtime and saving setup details
stage.start: Initializing the database and starting services
stage.cleanup: Removing initial setup credentials and refreshing services
error.stoppedShell: Installation stopped. Configuration and data are retained. Do not delete .env or database storage to retry.
error.terminal: Setup requires an interactive terminal for hidden password input. Run the installer directly in a terminal, without piping or redirecting input/output.
input.defaultsNotice: Values in [] are defaults. Press Enter to accept the default values. You can change these after signing in.
connection.notice: Server connection settings can be changed later in .env. HTTPS requires your own TLS reverse proxy.
connection.httpsNotice: Sign-in from other PCs requires HTTPS for secure session cookies. Configure a TLS proxy and an HTTPS application URL before use.
password.notice: Choose your sign-in password: 12–1024 characters, including uppercase, lowercase and a number. Input is hidden.
password.invalid: Password does not meet the requirements.
profile.notice: Change these personal details later in Settings > Profile.
employment.notice: Change these employment details later in Employees.
language.notice: Your chosen language is also your initial application language. Change it in Settings > Localization.
configuration.saved: Configuration saved. Secrets were not displayed. Keep .env safe and back it up separately from the database.
connection.url: Application URL (use the server hostname or IP for other PCs)
configuration.failed: Setup input or configuration saving failed. Check the preceding message and folder write permissions. An existing .env will not be overwritten.
error.dockerConnection: The docker info command failed: Docker could not be accessed. Check that Docker Desktop or the Docker daemon is running, the Docker context points to the intended server, and your account has access.
error.compose: Docker responded, but docker compose version failed. Install or repair Docker Compose v2 and confirm that docker compose version works in this terminal.
error.pull: Could not download the node:22-alpine setup image. The underlying cause could not be determined safely. Check registry connectivity, proxy settings and Docker disk space; retry docker pull node:22-alpine.
error.settings: Could not read the saved installation settings. Check that .env exists, its APP_ORIGIN and HTTP_PORT are valid, and Docker can read the installation folder. Do not share secret values.
error.build: Service image build failed. The underlying cause could not be determined safely. Check network access, Docker disk space and the complete release files.
error.start: Database initialization or service startup failed, or services did not become healthy within 300 seconds. Check the migration job and service status, HTTP port conflicts and Docker resources. The underlying cause could not be determined safely.
error.health: The local API or application did not return the expected response. Check gateway, frontend, API and database service status and the HTTP_PORT setting.
error.cleanup: Could not prepare or replace .env to remove initial setup credentials. Check write permissions and whether .env.install-clean already exists. These files may contain secrets; keep them protected.
error.removeMigration: Could not remove the completed migration container. Check its state and Docker access. Database storage has not been deleted.
error.refreshDb: Could not recreate the database service without initial setup credentials, or it did not become healthy within 300 seconds. Check database service status and Docker resources; keep database storage.
error.refreshApi: Could not recreate the API service without initial setup credentials, or it did not become healthy within 300 seconds. Check API and database service status.
error.inspectCredentials: Could not inspect service configuration to verify removal of initial setup credentials. Installation cannot be marked complete. Check Docker access and database/API service status.
error.unexpected: An unexpected installer error occurred. Its underlying cause could not be determined safely. Use the stopped stage shown above to check file permissions and Docker access. Do not share .env or unredacted diagnostics.
error.interrupted: Installation was interrupted by a signal. Saved configuration and database storage may remain.
error.saveConfiguration: Could not save .env. Check installation folder write permissions and free disk space. An existing file will not be overwritten.
